test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Akash sold an article at a loss of 21%. If he had bought the item at 8% less and had sold it for ₹198 more, then he would have gained 5%. Find the cost price (in ₹) of the article.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Initial CP** be 100 units. Initial SP at 21% loss = 79 units.

New CP (8% less) = 92 units. New SP at 5% gain = 92 × 1.05 = 96.6 units.

Difference in SP = 96.6 − 79 = 17.6 units.

Given 17.6 units = ₹198. Therefore, 1 unit = 198 ÷ 17.6 = 11.25.

Initial CP = 100 × 11.25 = ₹1125.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial loss = 21%, New CP = 0.92 × Initial CP, Price increase = ₹198, Final gain = 5%.

**Formulas:** SP = CP × (100 ± P/L)% | CP = Initial cost of the article.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a26fd7387f3162193d97d30fd8bbd7c13d75c67207561e22a249050420961f8f.png] 

⇒ Let CP = x. Initial SP = 0.79x.

⇒ New CP = 0.92x. New SP = 0.92x × (1.05) = 0.966x.

⇒ According to the question: 0.966x − 0.79x = 198.

⇒ 0.176x = 198.

⇒ x = 198 ÷ 0.176 = 1125.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1125.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change in Profit

When both CP and SP change, the **resultant profit percentage** is calculated on the **new CP**, not the original one.

Unitary Method Application

In profit and loss word problems, assuming **CP as 100** simplifies calculations involving percentages and ratios.
